pullRequests.title: chore(release): 1.0.1
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: release/1.0.1
pullRequests.body:
Everything on develop since 1.0.0, released as launcher 1.0.1 (notes in launcher/release-notes/1.0.1.md).
Main change: Going Commando can be built and played from an installed launcher (#276). Before this, an installed launcher had no Going Commando program and kept asking for a rebuild. Also the Rebuild guards (#278, #283, with the CI fixes in #285), the Windows build fixes (#287), and the port changes since 1.0.0.
The merge commit keeps develop's tree, as in 1.0.0, because squash merges made…
